IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice-Mayor Craig Corman, Councilmember Mary Wells, City Treasurer

  1) PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item listed on the agenda.
  None.
  2) Review of June 30, 2025 Annual Financial Audit and Annual Comprehensive
  Financial Report (ACFR)

  The City’s external auditors presented to the Audit Committee. The auditors and Director
  of Finance responded to Committee member questions.

  3) Update from Shuster Consulting Group on Section 115 Trust Investment Portfolio

  Shuster Advisory Group LLC consultants presented to the Section 115 Trust Committee
  to review the Section 115 Trust Investment Portfolio. The consultants and Director of
  Finance responded to Committee member questions.

  4) ADJOURNMENT
  Date/Time: March 13, 2026 / 12:11 PM
